scenario: [ICOM.20.5.1] — "the validator rejects multi-segment access on non-`Json` slots", exercised. `qty` is `Int`, so `t.qty.reading` continues one segment past a slot that has no sub-path. `Int` has members, so a dotted segment past it is a member read ([LGRA.5.8.5], [LGRA.9.6.2]), and `reading` names no member of `Int`: DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_MEMBER. BAD_PATH is left to a bracket index (compiler/LGRA.5.8.5_bracket_past_scalar_slot); a dotted segment past a type with no members is UNKNOWN_MEMBER too. Either way the rule is refused rather than lowered: a single-segment reference becomes a VAR node and only a Json leaf lowers the remainder to an EJSP path, so there is no node shape for "sub-path of an Int". Path: dsc.typecheck `luni_7_1_access_type` -> `lgra_9_6_2_member_read` -> `unknown_member`.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    qty: Int mutable

rule r:
    Trig t where t.qty.reading > 0
->
    log info "chained"
